cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Can I keep one plant on your windowsill?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Excellent. Sunlight is available to guests. Shall we discuss the other pot?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've agreed the principle. Now we're negotiating the size of its audience.
